title: CakeFest 2023: The Official CakePHP Conference
content:
- our annual conference dedicated to CakePHP. One full workshop day (plus one hybrid day) that is an ideal way to learn as both beginners and advanced users, followed by days of presentations, discussions and talks on CakePHP related technologies. CakeFest 2023 will be held in Los Angeles, CA - we are excited to see you there! CakeFest 2023

Date: September 28, 29 & 30 Time: 09:00am PDT

Check out the full schedule on CakeFest.org
